_comment: Stage 0 contract. Every dynamic region in the canonical scorecard is marked once with <!--TOKEN:NAME-->...<!--/TOKEN:NAME--> and collapsed to {{NAME}}. 'scalar' = single computed value injected inline; 'region' = variable-length markup block Stage 3 renders from rows. Everything NOT listed here stays frozen chrome (CSS, masthead prose, verification explainer, hash-anatomy, table headers, scoring rules, disclaimer, footer, JS).

tokens.name: S_NETEDGE_CLS
tokens.desc: Net-edge color class: 'pos' (green) when net edge ≥ 0, else 'neg' (red).

tokens.name: S_INTEGRITY
tokens.desc: Footer hash-integrity coverage, e.g. '1 of 14 cryptographically verified · 13 illustrative'. Derived from per-row integrity.scheme over all rows.
